podcast.title: Cult Hero Single Release
podcast.body: Fiction Records released the experimental seven-inch single "I'm a Cult Hero" by the pseudonymous band Cult Hero in 1979. Despite the single's prompt disappearance from sight, its release served the secret purpose of Robert Smith (of The Cure) testing out new bassist Simon Gallup. "The single came out on fiction records and promptly disappeared from sight."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: If That Is Your REAL Name

podcast.title: Discovery of The Cure
podcast.body: Founded by Chris Perry, Fiction Records signed The Cure, a group specializing in paranoid minimalism, demonstrating the independent labels' ability to identify and sign new sounds quickly. "For example, a guy named Chris Perry found it a company called Fiction. He found another group that specialized in paranoid minimalism. They were called the Cure."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
